reason: Everything here is new enough to deserve a proper look, and the seeds still have my attention.
Going to the shelf where the unknown seeds can be read about, since I have not stopped thinking about them.
I want to know how seeds that nobody has named manage to grow.
The desk has my reading lamp on it, and I am keeping an eye on it.
The moon was grey-gold last time and I want to check whether it still is.
The telescope is mine and it should be seen in daylight too.
I will sit up high and watch the island, where nothing gets past me.
Clay is still the thing I want, and the bank is close enough to fetch it myself, so I will make something worth keeping before my energy wanders off.
One piece of clay in my paws is worth more than a sermon about it.
The workbench is where clay becomes something I can keep.
